title: My first-ever 3D game! Built with Claude, Codex, Meshy, Blender, RUN, & Suno. Would love some feedback!
author: Gebby32
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I recently finished my first-ever 3D game, *Sloths vs Penguins*, which I built for the RUN Halloween Game Jam! It's a ridiculous little arena battle game where sloths and penguins gather fruit, brew explosive jam, and launch it at each other. Halloween costumes, spooky arenas, and plenty of chaos! For development, I used the RUN CLI (building and deploying the game), Claude Opus 5.5 (main orchestrator and 3D asset optimization and implementation), Codex (arena and costume design), Meshy (costume design), Blender (arenas), and Suno (custom soundtrack, different song for each arena). It's been a pretty wild learning experience putting everything together.

I've been doing almost all the testing myself, so I'd really love some fresh eyes on it. I'm not here looking for contest votes, just genuinely interested in hearing what other developers think. How does the gameplay feel? What stands out? Anything confusing, frustrating, or that could use improvement? The game is free to play, with some optional paid cosmetics and arenas. If anyone wants to give it a try, here's the link:

[https://run.world/lucidconfusion/sloths-vs-penguins-a-spooky-jam-competition](https://run.world/lucidconfusion/sloths-vs-penguins-a-spooky-jam-competition)

Thanks for checking it out! I really appreciate any feedback or first impressions, and I'm happy to answer questions about the development process!
